shared_elements: procession of standing human figures in profile
bearded male figures with rounded curled hairstyle and headdress/cap
figures carrying bowls, vessels or handled objects with both hands
figures walking in single file facing the same direction
low-relief frieze along a horizontal register
robed figure holding a staff / long rod
justification: Both show a single-file procession of bearded, curly-haired men in long robes, rendered in shallow profile relief with identical proportions and hair/beard conventions, several carrying bowls or vessels held forward in both hands, and a staff-bearing attendant among them. The main differences in depicted content are B's added camel head, rosette band and rows of spear-bearers behind, which A does not show; otherwise the scheme is effectively the same.
